Maya (Design): Quick design check — suppression scheduling + severity color in alert preview. Need a11y + keyboard flow sign-off. cc @Sanjay @Tara Sanjay (PM): Short background: customers confuse 'suppress' vs 'snooze'. Also they lose the preview state when they open channel picker and come back. Two asks: microcopy and preview persistence. Tara (Accessibility): +1 to tackling both. 'Snooze' reads friendlier and clearer to non-SRE users. Recommend label 'Snooze window' for the UI, keep 'suppression' in the API/advanced docs. Also we need aria announcements when preview changes. Maya (Design): Proposal: surface 'Snooze window' as the primary label, tooltip: "Temporarily silence alerts for X duration". Add severity visual chips (Critical/High/Medium/Low) with color + icon — but ensure contrast. Thoughts on keeping preview live when modal is closed? Tara (Accessibility): For aria, use an assertive live region for preview updates when severity or channels change. Example snippet: ```html
Preview updated: will notify 2 channels
``` This way screen readers announce the new preview summary. Alex (Eng): Implementation notes: yellow chips are tricky for contrast at small sizes. Suggest an outline + icon (exclamation/circle) so color isn't the sole cue. For preview persistence: simplest is session storage keyed by route+user, e.g. expire on tab close or after 24h. Sanjay (PM): UX decision needed: persist across routes during session (so users can tweak channels and come back) vs persist forever until they save. My vote: session-only. Maya (Design): Mocked two patterns — inline severity chips inside the rule row vs a left-rail severity badge. ASCII quick mock: [Rule name] [Snooze window: 1h] [Chip: CRIT 🔴] [Preview ▸] vs [🔴] [Rule name] [Snooze: 1h] [Preview ▸] Which is less noisy? Alex (Eng): I'm leaning left-rail badge for scanability. For persistence example code: ```js localStorage.setItem(`preview:${userId}:${route}`, JSON.stringify(state)) ``` We'll scope it to session by clearing on sign-out. Tara (Accessibility): Keyboard flow nit: after scheduling (open date picker → confirm), focus should return to the 'Snooze window' summary and the new state should be announced. Add `aria-describedby` linking to a details paragraph for screen readers. Maya (Design): Actionable: change label to 'Snooze window', add icon+outline to chips, session-only preview persistence, aria-live for announcements. Quick vote: reply with :thumbsup: to approve or :thumbsdown: to request changes. Sanjay (PM): I'll update the copy doc and route the translation strings. Action items: Maya update mocks, Alex prototype localStorage behavior, Tara formalize aria snippets for dev. Thanks team ✨ DesignBot: Design task created — DGN-4523 — 'Snooze label + preview persistence' assigned to Maya, Alex, Tara. ETA: next week.
